title: Spanakopita
subtitle: spinach and feta filo pie
description: Fresh spinach, spring onions, herbs and sheep's feta baked in layers of olive oil brushed filo. The feta is salty enough that no extra salt is needed. Makes one 15 x 25 cm pie.

steps.text: Wilt the spinach in a pot with a little water, stirring occasionally, until it loses its volume and softens. Drain, squeeze gently and cool.
Mix the spinach in a bowl with the spring onions, parsley and dill. Crumble in the feta and mix.
Beat the eggs in a small bowl, add to the mixture and stir.
Cut the filo sheets in half to make 10 sheets slightly larger than the tin. Brush the base of the tin with olive oil, lay down a sheet and brush with oil. Add 2 more sheets the same way.
Lay a sheet across the centre of the tin so half of it hangs over the edge, brush with oil, and repeat on the 3 remaining sides.

Fill the tin with the spinach mixture and level with a spoon. Fold the overhanging pastry over the filling one side at a time, brushing with oil. Add another sheet, brush with oil, and repeat with the 2 remaining sheets. Tuck the edges in and brush the sides with oil too.
Bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for about 35 minutes until nicely golden. Serve hot, warm or cold.
